verdict.rationale: Aleph documents versioned forecasts and scenario modeling as part of its FP&A platform, so per-scenario modeling is its own capability. Nothing in the evidence mentions burn, cash runway, or a zero-cash date being computed for each scenario, so only the scenario half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented burn and runway calculation per scenario, zero-cash-date output or comparison across scenarios, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
